# Kraft Tax

> A wait list asking one question: "Would you pay to send a box of Kraft Dinner to Soraya Martinez Ferrada?" People sign up to show their interest in sending a box of Kraft Dinner to the office of the mayor of Montreal and to be told when sending opens.

- Status: wait list. No payments are taken.
- Signing up: enter an email address at https://krafttax.vercel.app/. It is free.
- Recipient: the office of the mayor of Montreal (Cabinet de la mairesse), 275 Notre-Dame Street East, Montréal, Québec.
- Languages: English and French (https://krafttax.vercel.app/?lang=fr).
- Independent project, not affiliated with Kraft Heinz, the Ville de Montréal, or the mayor's office.

## FAQ

### What is this?

A wait list for people who want to send a box of Kraft Dinner to the office of the mayor of Montreal, Soraya Martinez Ferrada. Signing up registers your interest and puts you first in line when sending opens.

### Do I pay anything now?

No. Joining the wait list is free and only takes an email address. No payment details are collected.

### How much will a box cost?

The price is not set yet. It will cover the box and shipping to Montreal city hall. People on the wait list will hear the price first.

### What happens with my email?

It is used for one thing: to tell you when sending opens. It is not sold or shared.

### Is this affiliated with Kraft Heinz or the City of Montreal?

No. This is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Kraft Heinz, the Ville de Montréal, or the mayor's office.
